name: jerith edge shield — bootstrap flood cap
description: Edge-layer rate limit complementing the origin per-IP limiter (RUNBOOK 'Edge layer'): absorbs floods before they cost origin CPU, and outlives origin restarts (which reset local windows). NOT a replacement — direct-reachable surfaces and QUIC NodeRPC are origin-limiter-only.

rules.description: bootstrap public reads: <= 100 req/10s per IP, block 10s (free-plan parameters; Pro upgrade: period 60, requests_per_period 200, mitigation_timeout 3600)
rules.expression: (not cf.client.bot) and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1/peers") or http.request.uri.path eq "/v1/advertise" or http.request.uri.path eq "/health")
